name: print-social-luxury-property-post-with-dusk-tower
title: Property post with dusk skyline, centred caps title and glass info card
whatItIs: A tall image of a modern apartment building at sunset over a city skyline. A dark bold 'ELYSIUM HILLS' and a light tagline sit in the sky. At the bottom left a frosted brown glass card shows price per square metre and city.
whatItMeans: Serene and premium; text in the clear sky and a quiet glass card keep the photo dominant.
techniques: Place headline text in the clear part of the sky for legibility.
Overlay a translucent card for price and location.
Use a warm gradient sky against a cool blue-grey top.
Keep type minimal: bold caps title plus light tagline.

vocabulary.definition: Text placed over the clear sky area of a photo.
A frosted translucent box holding key facts.
A short line stating cost and place.
